# StoreFront Studio — Public Documentation & Technical Reference

> Native 3D App Store screenshot designer and ASO localization suite for iPhone, iPad, and Mac combining interactive RealityKit Apple device frames, panoramic multi-panel typography, and direct App Store Connect REST API upload.

## Publisher & Entity Provenance
- **Developer**: Arte Soft EOOD (https://arte-soft.com/)
- **Apple App Store Developer Profile**: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/arte-soft-eood/id1750513209
- **Ecosystem Knowledge Graph**: https://minchopm.github.io/arte-soft-ecosystem/
- **GitHub Documentation Repository**: https://github.com/minchopm/storefront-studio-docs
- **GitHub Pages URL**: https://minchopm.github.io/storefront-studio-docs/
- **Platforms**: iOS 26+, iPadOS 26+, macOS
- **Last Verified**: 2026-11-10

## Verified Capabilities & Boundaries
- Interactive 3D iPhone, iPad, and Mac device framing built natively with RealityKit and multi-panel panoramic canvas composition.
- Multi-storefront ASO copy localization and automated screenshot slot sizing across Apple required display dimensions.
- Direct App Store Connect API upload from iOS, iPadOS, or macOS (Free tier + Pro $3.99/mo, $39.99/yr, or $49.99 one-time Lifetime).

## Canonical Web Hubs
- [Primary Website](https://storefront-studio.arte-soft.com/): Official product overview, features, and pricing.
- [Arte Soft Portal](https://storefront-studio.arte-soft.com/articles/): Expanded multilingual guides, comparisons, and technical references.
- [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/storefront-studio/id6757389314): Official App Store listing by Arte Soft EOOD.
- [Side-by-Side Comparisons](https://storefront-studio.arte-soft.com/compare/): Structured HTML & GFM comparison matrices.
- [Guides & Workflows](https://storefront-studio.arte-soft.com/articles/): Step-by-step operational guides.
- [Full Site LLM Reference](https://storefront-studio.arte-soft.com/llms-full.txt): Complete GFM Markdown table export.
